description:
## Instagram Patches

### Keep screen on while playing video
Keeps the screen on while a video is playing in the feed, stories and other places, like in Reels.

### Carousel auto scroll
Feed carousels move to the next item on their own when a video ends.
Images in between are shown for 5 seconds.
Turned on and off from the post ⋯ menu (off by default).

Tested on Instagram 439.0.0.37.89 (arm64-v8a).
